name: Pet Shop
title: Pet Shop
summary: The Pet Shop is a single Aluvian stone-and-timber cottage on a terrace (z 58) above the river valley, 560 m west-north-west of the Obsidian Span, where many pets (Armoredillo pup, baby drudge, ursuin cub...) are sold by six NPCs. Rabbit hutches stand by its south door, a 28 m tree behind it on the hillside.

landmarks.name: Pet Shop cottage

shots.standingOrder: Arc 30 deg clockwise at 30 m around the Pet Shop cottage, 12 m above the terrace on its south-east side; keep 6 m from the two trees south of the cottage, their leaves may be faded.
shots.notes: The Aluvian cottage near the Obsidian Span where pets are sold: stone-and-timber walls, a door each side, rabbit hutches by the south door, set on a terrace above the river valley with a 28 m tree behind it. A short sweeping arc from the south-east, sun from the right.
